text: Starlink started with a speech in Seattle — quoting: ELON MUSK’S 2015 SATELLITE VISION IS NOW THE BIGGEST NETWORK ON EARTH. In 2015 Elon opened SpaceX’s satellite office in Seattle and said they wanted to change satellites the same way they changed rockets. Eleven years later Starlink has more than 11,100 satellites in orbit.
zh: 马斯克：星链始于西雅图的一次演讲 — 引用称2015年他在西雅图开设SpaceX卫星办公室，要用改变火箭的方式改变卫星；11年后星链在轨卫星已超过11100颗

text: Moving all text conversations to be encrypted to ensure user privacy
zh: 马斯克：所有文字对话将改为加密以保障用户隐私——引用称本周五起停止支持XChat旧版群组，未加密对话将全部加密，周五前未加入XChat的群成员需注册后才能重新进入。

text: X Money is growing fast
zh: 马斯克：X Money增长很快——引用称现已可从X直接向27个国家进行国际银行转账，收款人按当地货币到账。

text: Yes. Only questions are how fast the singularity will grow and to what size. — quoting: guys we're in the fucking singularity. oh my god. i just forget sometimes and then wake up in the middle of the night like oh my god its all happening
zh: 马斯克：是的。问题只在于奇点会增长多快、会到多大规模。 — 引用：有人说我们已身处奇点之中，有时夜里醒来才突然意识到这一切正在发生。

text: President Donald J. Trump meets with Russian President Vladimir Putin at the APEC Summit in Shenzhen, China.
zh: 白宫：特朗普在深圳APEC峰会会见俄罗斯总统普京。

text:
JUST NOW: President Donald J. Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin meet in China.

"We've known each other for a long time, and I think a lot of wonderful things can come out of this — or at least start."
zh: 白宫：特朗普与普京在华会面；特朗普称相识已久，相信由此可产生许多好事，或至少由此起步。

text: Really neat part of Genie 4 is you can type new prompts while exploring a generated world, like dropping in characters or changing the scene + the native audio adapts in real time! Now available in Project Genie for eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers.
zh: 皮查伊：Genie 4可在探索生成世界时输入新提示，如加入角色或改变场景，原生音频也会实时适配；现已向符合条件的Google AI Ultra订阅用户在Project Genie中开放。

text: President Donald J. Trump greets Chinese President Xi Jinping as he arrives at the APEC Summit in Shenzhen.
zh: 白宫：特朗普在深圳APEC峰会迎接中国国家主席习近平到场。

text: Catching the ship was the last major piece of the puzzle — quoting: Elon Musk on why the historic Starship catch is a much bigger milestone than most people realize. “Catching the ship was the final major piece.” SpaceX has now achieved: 3 successful Super Heavy booster catches; a booster that was reflown and caught again; the FIRST EVER.
zh: 马斯克：捕捉飞船是拼图的最后一块关键部分。

text:
We’ve priced our IPO at $83 per share, with trading expected to begin on Nasdaq tomorrow.

Legal disclaimer: A registration statement relating to the Class A common stock was declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 18,
zh: Anthropic：IPO发行价定为每股83美元，预计明天在纳斯达克开始交易。

text: As Texas communities consider major supercomputing investments, careful long-term tax planning is essential. Under Texas’s no-new-revenue tax framework, rising property values generally drive tax rates down. But as expensive computing equipment rapidly depreciates, this can — quoting @outerspacetoday: JUST IN: Texas officials have rejected SpaceX's request to advance a property tax break for a proposed $24 billion data center and power plant near Starbase.
zh: SpaceX：得州社区若大举投资超算，须做好长期税收规划；引用称得州官员已拒绝其为星舰基地附近240亿美元数据中心和电厂申请的税收减免。

text:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponentially, and agents are completing longer tasks, but human involvement remains central in research. Researchers are also spending more time on safety and
zh: OpenAI：公布内部研究新数据，研究人员使用AI呈指数上升，智能体可完成更长任务，但人仍是研究核心，且花在安全上的时间在增加。

text:
President Trump has one priority on his mind: the American people.

$17 billion in commercial deals and strategic investments for U.S. companies secured. 🇺🇸
zh: 白宫：称已为美国公司争取到170亿美元商业协议与战略投资。

text:
A successful stellar merger 🤝

Scientists recently spotted a star slightly less massive than the Sun merging into a puffy supergiant star in the outskirts of the Andromeda galaxy. This hard-to-observe event resulted in a new star nicknamed "Bao."
zh: NASA：在仙女座星系外围观测到一颗略小于太阳的恒星并入膨胀超巨星，合并后的新星被称作“Bao”。

text:
Gemini 4 Neon: frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.

Begins rolling out today in the Gemini API in @GoogleAIStudio, Gemini for business, for paid Google AI Pro and Ultra
zh: 皮查伊：Gemini 4 Neon即日起在Gemini API、Google AI Studio、企业版及付费Pro/Ultra用户中推出，主打复杂软件工程、知识工作与科学流程的快速端到端完成。

text: We’re sharing how we approach safety at every stage of a model’s lifecycle, from early research to internal use to public deployment.
zh: OpenAI：介绍其在模型从早期研究、内部使用到公开发布各阶段的安全做法。

text: We have posted the minutes from the #FOMC meeting held October 27-28, 2026:
zh: 美联储：已公布2026年10月27日至28日FOMC会议纪要。

text:
Speech by Governor Barr on community development investments @NewYorkFed:

Learn more about Governor Barr:
zh: 美联储：巴尔理事就社区发展投资发表讲话。

text: Bringing Salesforce to Copilot as we build Copilot as the OS for work! — quoting @salesforce: Introducing Copilotforce. Salesforce customer context and sales workflows are coming to Copilot and Teams.
zh: 纳德拉：将把Salesforce接入Copilot，并把Copilot打造成工作操作系统。——引用Salesforce：推出Copilotforce，客户与销售流程将进入Copilot和Teams。

text: Today, Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) designated the Wa Ta’awanu Association, a charity that provides cover for Hizballah’s activities under the guise of delivering humanitarian services. OFAC today also designated members of a Lebanon- and Türkiye-based gold
zh: 美国财政部：海外资产控制办公室将以慈善为名掩护真主党活动的Wa Ta’awanu协会，以及一个黎巴嫩与土耳其黄金网络的成员列入制裁名单。

text:
After nearly 50 years, Voyager 1 has traveled more than one light-day from Earth.

Hear about what the Voyager mission has taught us about our solar system—and beyond—in the newest episode of our Curious Universe podcast:
zh: NASA：旅行者1号在近50年后已飞离地球超过1光日。

text:
In collaboration with @ndstudio, we’re excited to share that EDGAR content is now available through  🎉

This enhancement expands access to market information, helping investors, researchers, market participants, and the public interact with EDGAR data in
zh: 美国证交会：EDGAR内容已通过新渠道开放，便于投资者、研究与市场参与者获取相关市场信息。

text: .@ODNIgov Director Jay Clayton tells congress on recent tech outages: "We have no evidence that this is a coordinated cyberattack or state-sponsored activity." ⤵️
zh: 白宫：国家情报总监克莱顿向国会表示，近期技术故障没有证据表明是协同网络攻击或国家支持的行动。

text:
Working with @AMD, our models identified up to 14% PPA improvement on flagship GPU IP in less than five months—building on designs AMD’s engineers had already spent years optimizing.

The same approach helped improve Jalapeño, our first custom inference chip, with gains verified
zh: OpenAI：与AMD合作，不到五个月即在其旗舰GPU IP上识别出最高14%的PPA（性能-功耗-面积）改进，并据此改进首款自研推理芯片Jalapeño。

text: The Starbase tower team on location with the first caught Starship🍌
zh: SpaceX：星舰基地塔架团队在现场展示首次被塔架成功捕捉的星舰。

text:
Is the Thucydides Trap ever avoidable?

I wish it were, but, inevitably, the most interesting outcome is the most likely.
zh: 马斯克：修昔底德陷阱恐怕难以避免，最有戏剧性的结局往往也最可能发生。

text: “The best way to deal with people’s uncertainty and discomfort is to share with them transparently what we know… Every indicator that we have is that every single one of these events has an explanation or a cause that has nothing to do with a cyber criminal, has nothing to do with a hostile actor or another country.” - Secretary of State Marco Rubio
zh: 白宫：国务卿鲁比奥称，现有迹象表明这些事件均有解释或原因，与网络犯罪、敌对势力或他国无关。

text: Building the future of AI takes a global supply chain. We’re expanding commitments with Amkor Technology, Foxconn, Kinsus, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, SPIL and TSMC, building on previously announced commitments with IBIDEN, KYEC and Unimicron. Together, we’re building the
zh: 英伟达：将扩大与安靠、富士康、景硕、三星电机、矽品和台积电的合作承诺，并延续此前与揖斐电、京元电子和欣兴电子的安排，加码全球 AI 供应链。

text: The Starbase tower chopsticks catching their first Starship. This unique architecture was designed for full and rapid reusability, enabling repeat launches and landings from the same pad
zh: SpaceX：星舰基地发射塔“筷子”完成首次捕获星舰；该架构旨在实现快速完全重复使用，可在同一发射台反复发射和着陆。

text: "This is not a cyberattack and this is not a coordinated effort by a nation-state." - Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton.
zh: 白宫：国家情报总监克莱顿称，此事并非网络攻击，也不是某个国家的协同行动。

text: NEWS: NVIDIA announces financial results for third quarter fiscal 2027. Revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago. Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion, up 110% from a year ago.
zh: 英伟达：公布 2027 财年第三季度业绩，营收 1158 亿美元、同比增长 103%，数据中心营收 1076 亿美元、同比增长 110%。

text: With Meta’s latest models coming to Foundry, we’re giving developers and enterprises even more choice and flexibility! — quoting: Muse Wonder, Muse Spark 1.3, and Muse Ember are coming soon to Microsoft Foundry on @Azure.
zh: 纳德拉：Meta 最新模型将登陆 Foundry，为开发者和企业提供更多选择 —— 引用称：Muse Wonder、Muse Spark 1.3 和 Muse Ember 即将登陆 Azure 上的 Microsoft Foundry。

text: 6.2 Sol and Astra are out. These models can do amazing things and are very token-efficient; we hope people will get great value from them. In particular, 6.2 Sol ultrafast is something I think people will really enjoy.
zh: 奥特曼：GPT-6.2 的 Sol 与 Astra 已发布，强调高 token 效率；尤其推荐 6.2 Sol 超快版。

text: Congress was warned. FAA infrastructure badly needs funding. The old systems need to be upgraded for the safety and security of the American people.
zh: 白宫：国会此前已接到警告；联邦航空管理局基础设施急需拨款，旧系统须升级，以保障美国民众的安全。

text: After 34 days docked to the @Space_Station, the Dragon spacecraft supporting SpaceX’s 35th Commercial Resupply Services mission for @NASA is targeted to undock from the orbiting lab as soon as Wednesday, November 18
zh: SpaceX：执行第 35 次商业补给任务的龙飞船在空间站停靠 34 天后，最早将于 11 月 18 日（周三）撤离。

text: President Trump continues to safeguard American citizens, and today @FinCENnews proposal takes the next step in implementing the President’s historic Executive Order, “Restoring Integrity to America’s Financial System.” This action will strengthen customer due diligence
zh: 美国财政部：金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）今日提出新方案，落实“恢复美国金融体系诚信”行政令，将加强客户尽职调查。

text: Some of you have been asking very politely. Some of you have just been asking. GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are now available. Super efficient and built to perform where it counts—the real world.
zh: OpenAI：GPT-6.2 的 Astra 与 Sol 现已上线，称其高效并面向实际应用。

text: Knowing things → doing things → finding ways to save you time and money. We’re expanding Tasks in Gemini free of charge to hundreds of millions of people in six countries. Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Tasks lets you hand off everyday life admin directly: - Forward emails to
zh: 皮查伊：将向六个国家数亿用户免费开放 Gemini 任务功能，由 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 驱动，可代办邮件转发等日常事务。

text: Join us in getting a look at the universe as it has never been seen before. On Dec. 7, at 3:30pm ET (2030 UTC), @NASARoman’s first images will be unveiled during a livestream from @theAGU Annual Meeting. Learn how to tune in:
zh: NASA：罗马太空望远镜首批图像将于 12 月 7 日 15:30（美东时间，世界时 20:30）在美国地球物理联合会年会上直播公布。

text: Advanced solid state transformers at scale from Tesla — quoting: Introducing Powercore. Solid state medium voltage transformer, inverter and breaker – reliable, safe and secure. 7.4 MW/9 MVA continuously at 34.5 kVac w/ grid-forming support for 10MVA of peak power. Made in America. Operating 2027
zh: 马斯克：特斯拉将大规模推出先进固态变压器 —— 引用称：Powercore 为固态中压变压器、逆变器与断路器一体，可持续输出 7.4 兆瓦/9 兆伏安，并支持 10 兆伏安峰值，美国制造，2027 年投运。
